HON.rationale: HON reported a strong Q2 2026 with revenue of $9.72B (+4.3% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $4.52 beating consensus of $1.80, driven by 4% organic growth and 100bps segment margin expansion. The aerospace spin-off completed June 29, 2026, creating a more focused Honeywell Technologies entity. Current P/E of 9.55 is dramatically below the 12-month range of 9.5-37.0, suggesting the market is pricing in post-spin-off uncertainty and lower forward guidance (Q3 EPS guidance of $2.05-2.20 vs consensus $2.85). The $38B backlog and 16% organic order growth provide demand visibility, while Building Automation's 9% organic growth and 27.1% margin demonstrate segment strength. However, Process Automation weakness (-1% organic), elevated debt ($31.5B), and the one-time Quantinuum gain inflating reported EPS ($17.83) temper enthusiasm. The stock appears undervalued relative to its own history given the P/E compression from ~24x to ~10x, though this partly reflects the structural change from the spin-off.
